raised: The chosen fund has only one year of history behind its -0.04% gap, against three years for Tachlit
Unsure whether Psagot allows an automatic monthly purchase
Only Leumi is marked 'standing-order price', so Psagot's price may assume buying by hand
Confused by the line 'no foreign fund operating in Israel': should foreign funds worry them?
Inflation button is half-confusing: is the 7% before or after inflation?
The line chart's 'years: 18,905 ₪ more' says nothing about where to invest
Step chart starts from Harel at Bank Jerusalem, a choice they never made, and they got lost
The last 'Now: Harel Sal… Jerusalem' tables repeat the account list
Orange and yellow bars in the account list can't be told apart without going back to the legend
Doesn't understand '4A' and the '(40)' in fund names
Doesn't understand tracking fund vs ETF, or why a tracking fund is cheaper
Fee terms 'variable' and 'trustee' unexplained: do they pay all of them?
'עמלות זו על זו' has no explanation
Unclear why tax is the biggest cost and whether anything can be done about it
'Open tax rule: shown but not ranked' is unexplained
Can't understand the 'cut-off bar' note
Unclear whether the fund can really be bought at One Zero, given the 'doubtful whether sold there' note
Unclear whether 'foreign funds waiting for unit price' affects them
No guidance on how to actually open a Psagot account or set up monthly buying
No information on whether money is safe at Psagot compared with a bank
No hint of what price is reasonable to negotiate with their current bank
Age discount is marked 'not in calculation', and how much it would change is not shown
No information on exit fees when withdrawing early
Worry whether a one-year-old fund might close or merge
Would drop the other index buttons and the funds filter with its tags

problems.why: The reader actually found the 'מול המדד' explanation and column helpful and never says the column is useless or that the table is missing the information that matters; their worry about one year of history is about how reliable the figure is, not about whether the column is useful.
